verdict.rationale: Codex Cloud supports starting tasks from external triggers like GitHub PRs, GitLab MRs/issues, Linear issues, and Slack messages, and can run tasks in parallel in isolated cloud environments — giving some trigger-based automation. However there's no explicit documentation of true scheduled/cron-based 'always-on' agents that proactively monitor and fix software without a human-initiated trigger, and community evidence shows real reliability limits (tight usage limits, slowness, quota resets) that would undermine an unattended always-on workflow. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron support, evidence of continuous autonomous monitoring rather than reactive triggers, and independent confirmation of reliable unattended long-running operation.
